comparison.objective: Snug an adjustable wrench and loosen a nut without rounding it; candidate positions and locks a sensor mount.
comparison.physical_skill: Adjusting wrench jaw clearance and directional pulling versus controlled screw loosening and constrained sensor translation.
comparison.success_condition: Nut loosened ≥60°, wrench removed, with irreversible jaw/direction faults; candidate requires two over-center, ≤6 mm sensor endpoints.
comparison.reason: No sensor registration or hold-while-fastening is tested in the record. Candidate lacks screw dimensions, torque limits, and exact indicator transition/hysteresis.
